evidence.title: How to use react-icons in React with TypeScript - DEV Community

name: How to use react-icons in React with TypeScript
summary: dev.to tutorial on using the react-icons package in React with TypeScript by wrapping icons in one typed reusable component.
description: Tutorial by Tapesh Patel (June 2024): install react-icons and prop-types, import an icon and the IconType type from react-icons, then build a small IconComponent that takes a typed icon prop and renders it, so any icon such as FaDev can be used like a normal React component. Covers the typing errors that appear when the icon library is used without types.
contains: install react-icons and prop-types with npm
import icons and the IconType type from react-icons
reusable IconComponent with a typed icon prop
